senses.gloss: यया॑ति m. (prob. fr. √ यत्) N. of a celebrated monarch of the lunar race (son of king Nahuṣa whom he succeeded ; from his two wives came the two lines of the lunar race, Yadu being the son of Devayānī, daughter of Uśanas or Śukra, and Puru of Śarmiṣṭhā, daughter of Vṛṣa-parvan; Yayāti Nāhuṣa is also represented as the author of RV. ix, 101, 4-6), RV.; MaitrUp.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
ययाति—चरित n. ‘the story of Yayāti’, N. of a Nāṭaka (by Rudra-deva).
ययाति—जा f. patr. of Mādhavī, MBh.
ययाति—पतन n. ‘fall of Y˚’, N. of a place of pilgrimage, ib.
ययाति—व॑त् ind. like Y˚, RV.
ययाति—विजय m. ‘Y˚ victory’, N. of wk.
ययातिक m. (mc.) = ययाति, AgP.
यायातिक m. one conversant with the history of Yayāti, Pat. on Pāṇ. iv, 2, 60.
ययावर॑ v.l. for यायावर॑.
यायावर॑ mfn. (fr. Intens.) going about, having no fixed or permanent abode, TS. &c. &c.
यायावर॑ m. a vagrant mendicant, saint, Bhaṭṭ.
a Brāhman who has preserved his household-fire (?), W.
‘wandering at large’, a horse selected for a horse-sacrifice, L.
pl. (also with गणाः) N. of a family of Brāhmans (to which Jarat-kāru belongs), MBh. (sg. = जरत्-कारु, L.)
यायावर॑ n. the life of a vagrant mendicant, BhP.
यायावर यायिन्. See p. 850, col. 1.
ययि॑ mfn. (√ या) going, hastening, quick, RV.
ययि॑ m. a cloud, ib.
ययी॑ mfn. = ययि॑, RV.
ययी॑ m. a horse, L.
N. of Śiva, L.
ययिन् mfn. = prec. (see नि-ययि॑न्)
ययिन् m. N. of Śiva, L.

यायिन् mfn. (mostly ifc.) going, moving, riding, driving, flying, travelling, marching, taking the field, going to war (also applied to planets opposed to each other in the ग्रह-युद्ध, q.v.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
य॑यु mfn. (ययु॑ in a corrupted passage, AV. iv, 24, 2) going, moving, swift (applied to a horse), VS.
य॑यु m. a horse (esp. ‘one fit for sacrifice’), L.
N. of one of the horses of the Moon, VP.
the way of final beatitude, L.
य॑यु f. obtaining, L.
य॑यु mfn. having a long stick, L.
यायजू॑क mf(आ)n. (fr. Intens. of √ 1. यज्) constantly sacrificing, devout, ŚBr.
यायजू॑क m. a performer of frequent sacrifices, L.
यायष्टि f. the frequent performance of sacrifices, Pāṇ. i, 1, 58, Vārtt. 7, Pat.
यायात mf(ई)n. (fr. ययाति) relating or belonging to Yayāti, MBh.; Hariv.
यायात n. the history of Yayāti (N. of ch. of BhP.)
